unit_cn: Unit 6 Disaster and Hope 灾难与希望
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 6 词表(p61-71 真词)+本单元内容词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、灾难/救援/希望主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: An earthquake is one of the most frightening natural disasters.
words.example_cn: 地震是最令人恐惧的自然灾难之一。

words.example_en: Even in the worst disaster, kind words can give people hope.
words.example_cn: 即使在最严重的灾难中,善意的话也能给人希望。

words.example_en: The hurricane tore the roofs off many houses near the coast.
words.example_cn: 飓风把海岸边许多房屋的屋顶都掀掉了。

words.example_en: A strong typhoon brought heavy rain and huge waves to the city.
words.example_cn: 一场强台风给这座城市带来了暴雨和巨浪。

words.example_en: The earthquake under the sea caused a giant tsunami.
words.example_cn: 海底地震引发了一场巨大的海啸。

words.example_en: When the earthquake hit, the whole building began to shake.
words.example_cn: 地震来袭时,整栋楼开始摇晃。

words.example_en: Heavy rain caused a terrible flood that turned the streets into rivers.
words.example_cn: 暴雨引发了可怕的洪水,把街道变成了河流。

words.example_en: After months of drought, not a single drop of rain had fallen.
words.example_cn: 数月干旱过后,没有落下一滴雨。

words.example_en: The wildfire spread across the dry hills within a few hours.
words.example_cn: 山火在几个小时内就蔓延到了干燥的山丘上。

words.example_en: Heavy snow led to an avalanche that buried a mountain road.
words.example_cn: 大雪引发雪崩,埋住了一条山路。

words.example_en: A blizzard brought metres of snow and trapped the villagers indoors.
words.example_cn: 一场暴风雪带来数米厚的积雪,把村民困在了室内。

words.example_en: Days of rain caused a landslide that blocked the only road out.
words.example_cn: 连日降雨引发滑坡,堵住了唯一的出路。

words.example_en: When the volcano began to erupt, everyone ran for safety.
words.example_cn: 火山开始喷发时,所有人都跑去避险。

words.example_en: Experts say such floods occur more often because of climate change.
words.example_cn: 专家说,由于气候变化,这样的洪水发生得更频繁了。

words.example_en: The avalanche claimed the lives of more than two hundred people.
words.example_cn: 这场雪崩夺去了两百多人的生命。

words.example_en: The rising water began to threaten the homes along the river.
words.example_cn: 上涨的河水开始威胁到河边的房屋。

words.meaning_cn: 威胁;可能带来危险的事物
words.example_en: Floods are a common threat to towns built near the coast.
words.example_cn: 洪水是对建在海岸边的城镇的常见威胁。

words.example_en: The long drought led to a serious food crisis in the region.
words.example_cn: 长期干旱导致该地区出现严重的粮食危机。

words.example_en: China quickly sent emergency aid to the area hit by the earthquake.
words.example_cn: 中国迅速向受地震影响的地区送去紧急援助。

words.example_en: An international rescue team searched the ruins for survivors.
words.example_cn: 一支国际救援队在废墟中搜寻幸存者。

words.example_en: When the storm hit, the family found shelter in the school hall.
words.example_cn: 暴风雨来袭时,这家人在学校礼堂里找到了避难所。

words.example_en: The weather forecast warned that a typhoon was on the way.
words.example_cn: 天气预报警告说,一场台风即将来临。

words.example_en: The radio made an announcement telling people to leave at once.
words.example_cn: 广播发出公告,叫人们立刻撤离。

words.example_en: Today, satellite data helps scientists track every coming storm.
words.example_cn: 如今,卫星数据帮助科学家追踪每一场来临的风暴。

words.example_en: For a reliable forecast, it is best to check an official report.
words.example_cn: 想要可靠的预报,最好查看官方报告。

words.example_en: Computers now help us predict the weather more precisely than before.
words.example_cn: 如今计算机帮助我们比以往更精确地预测天气。

words.example_en: The disaster was caused by exceptionally heavy snow in a short time.
words.example_cn: 这场灾难是由短时间内极其大的降雪造成的。

words.example_en: When you hear the warning, leave for the shelter immediately.
words.example_cn: 听到警报时,立刻前往避难所。

words.example_en: Do not drink the flood water; otherwise you may get really sick.
words.example_cn: 不要喝洪水,否则你可能会病得很重。

words.example_en: Our street had turned into a river, and we were going nowhere.
words.example_cn: 我们的街道变成了河流,我们哪儿也去不了。

words.example_en: If birds are flying low, grab your umbrella, for rain may come.
words.example_cn: 如果鸟飞得低,抓上你的雨伞,因为可能要下雨了。

words.example_en: Make sure you have sufficient food and water before the storm.
words.example_cn: 暴风雨来临前,确保你有足够的食物和水。

words.example_en: To protect your property, close the windows and tape them up.
words.example_cn: 为保护你的财产,关好窗户并用胶带封好。

words.example_en: Clean drinking water was sent to us by helicopter.
words.example_cn: 干净的饮用水是用直升机送给我们的。

words.example_en: Living in the open air, we were soon bitten by mosquitos.
words.example_cn: 住在露天里,我们很快就被蚊子叮咬了。

words.example_en: We lay under the midnight sky and looked up at the stars.
words.example_cn: 我们躺在午夜的天空下,仰望星星。

words.example_en: After the rescue, we were taken to a town in a faraway county.
words.example_cn: 获救后,我们被带到一个遥远县里的小镇。

words.example_en: I was sitting with my cat on my lap when the roof flew off.
words.example_cn: 屋顶被掀飞时,我正抱着猫坐在腿上。

words.example_en: During the heatwave, the temperature reached thirty degrees plus.
words.example_cn: 热浪期间,气温达到了三十多度。

words.example_en: On a hot day, the London Tube can be like a tube full of warm air.
words.example_cn: 炎热的日子里,伦敦地铁就像一根装满热空气的管子。

words.example_en: The hurricane caused billions of dollars in damage.
words.example_cn: 这场飓风造成了数十亿美元的损失。

words.example_en: Many people donated money and food to help the flood victims.
words.example_cn: 许多人捐钱捐物来帮助洪灾受灾者。

words.example_en: Rescue teams from many countries came to aid the injured.
words.example_cn: 来自许多国家的救援队前来援助伤员。

words.example_en: Being prepared is the best way to survive a disaster.
words.example_cn: 做好准备是在灾难中幸存下来的最好办法。

words.example_en: A year later, the families were working together to rebuild their homes.
words.example_cn: 一年后,这些家庭正齐心协力重建家园。

words.example_en: It was hard, but Mom told us to stay positive and see the good side.
words.example_cn: 尽管艰难,妈妈仍叫我们保持乐观,看到好的一面。

words.example_en: Read these safety guidelines so that your family can stay safe.
words.example_cn: 阅读这些安全指南,好让你的家人保持安全。

words.example_en: The storm caused great damage to homes and roads.
words.example_cn: 这场风暴对房屋和道路造成了巨大破坏。
